newsitem.title: USA: Renaissance files for 1.1 mln shares - SEC.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance files for 1.1 mln shares - SEC.

text.p: Renaissance Solutions Inc said Monday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 1.1 million common shares.

Of the total, 50,150 common shares will be sold by the company and 1,049,850 common will be sold by selling stockholders, the filing said. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 7,750,318 common.

The company granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option of up to 165,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Hambrecht & Quist, Cowen & Co and Robertson, Stephens & Co.
Net proceeds will be used for working capital and other general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions, the filing said.
Selling stockholders include Gemini Consulting Inc and the two co-chairman, Harry Lasker and David Lubin.
The company provides management consulting and client/server systems integration services, primarily for large corporations.
